verdict.rationale: HeyGen's own prompt-to-video model accepts an image as input and generates new 5–30 s clips, and its create-video endpoint accepts file inputs alongside style control. That gives a reference-image-driven generation path. However, nothing documents that the output adopts the reference's visual style. Video references are used to clone an avatar's identity (digital twin), not to transfer style, and the 'visual style' option is a preset picker (cinematic, handmade, retro), not reference-matching. Missing for 10: documented style transfer from a reference image, any reference-video-to-new-footage style generation, and hands-on or independent corroboration of style fidelity.

support.subject: As a creator, I can point at a reference video or image and generate new footage in that style
